Geomagic Wrap

Geomagic Wrap supports transforming point clouds and scans into polygonal 3D models.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Clean scan points

Use the selected scans, photographs or measured geometry and coordinate basis. In the intended Geomagic Wrap preview, clean scan points; the visible result is an aligned capture set with coverage and registration state visible. Review scale, overlap, control points and residual error before accepting or exporting it.

Build a watertight mesh

Start from the cleaned capture and nominal reference. In the intended Geomagic Wrap preview, build a watertight mesh; the visible result is a segmented, reconstructed or compared geometry result. Review noise, holes, alignment strategy and tolerance basis before accepting or exporting it.

Prepare a downstream surface

Begin with the reviewed mesh, surface, cloud or inspection characteristics. In the intended Geomagic Wrap preview, prepare a downstream surface; the visible result is an export or report tied to the captured source and coordinate system. Review deviation limits, completeness, units and downstream fitness before accepting or exporting it.
